facts.fact: The Ministry of Industry's page describes Medafrica Systems (Medasys) as a Moroccan multi-subsidiary company that inaugurated the Maroc Datacenter at Temara on 19 September 2017, a cloud platform on a '100% Moroccan site'; it calls the company Moroccan but gives no ownership shares, and says the project was initiated and funded in partnership with Morocco SME under the Imtiaz programme.

systems.owner: Medafrica Systems (Medasys), described as a Moroccan company
planned joint venture of Medasys and Zircom Group (UK)

note: No state fact: public administrations are named only as intended customers, not as hosted in the centre.
